summary: Iteration 28 testing completed for 6 NEW changes: 1) 5812 logo on badges/passes, 2) Existing badge reuse check, 3) People location filtering, 4) Outreach recurrence patterns, 5) Imported events user-scoped, 6) Imported events lighter gray styling. All 19 backend tests passed. Frontend UI verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 28 tested 6 new features: 1) People page has location filter dropdown with All Locations and specific locations, 2) Calendar page has Recurring Events dialog with Daily, Weekly, Biweekly, Monthly, Yearly, Nth Weekday patterns, 3) Events page Create Event form has Recurrence Type dropdown with all patterns, 4) Access Control Guest Passes QR modal shows 58:12 Global logo on top, 5) Backend APIs for members location filter, imported events user-scoping, event sharing, and recurring event generation all work correctly.

people_location_filter.details: Location filter dropdown visible with All Locations and 11 specific locations (58:12 Global Main, Haiti, Kenya, Rescue, Shelter, Uganda, United, Holmes County, TEST_Timezone_Location, Wayne County, Zimba Farm)

calendar_recurring_events.details: Recurring Events dialog shows all patterns: Daily, Every N Weeks, Bi-weekly, Every N Months, Yearly, Nth Weekday of Month, Nth Day of Month. Has Start Date, End Date, Occurrences fields.

events_recurrence_type.details: Create Event form has Recurrence Type dropdown with: Daily, Weekly (specific day), Bi-weekly, Monthly (same date), Monthly (nth weekday), Yearly (same date)

guest_pass_qr_logo.details: Guest Pass QR modal displays 58:12 Global logo on top of QR code

imported_events_user_scoped.details: Backend API GET /api/events?type=imported filters by user. PUT /api/events/{id}/share endpoint works.

imported_events_styling.details: Calendar legend shows 'Imported' type with gray color indicator

members_location_filter_api.details: GET /api/members?location_id=xxx returns filtered members. GET /api/members returns all.

event_deletion.details: DELETE /api/events/{id} works for all event types including imported events

outreach_recurring_patterns.details: POST /api/events/generate-recurring works with daily, weekly, biweekly, monthly, yearly, nth_week patterns for outreach type

guest_pass_existing_badge.details: GET /api/access/guest-passes returns has_existing_badge field. Backend checks both members AND users for existing badges.
